entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse and your website is useless. I want a refund, now. This is completely unacceptable.

I can certainly look into that return for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's not a fault, I can't use the damn thing! I've had a major family emergency. My husband is on military deployment, and our son had to be rushed to the hospital for emergency surgery! I've been there for over two weeks straight. I don't have time to be messing around with a fitness tracker.
Oh my, I am so sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly difficult, and I hope your son is recovering well. I can only imagine how stressful that must be, especially with your husband away.

Save the sympathy. Are you going to give me my money back or not? Because if not, I want your manager's name and number right now. I am not in the mood for games, and I will plaster this all over social media.
That won't be necessary, ma'am. I can absolutely handle this for you. Let me just pull up your order details... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 17 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Alright, I've got it here. Given everything you've been through, and the fact you're well within our 90-day return period, I can definitely process this for a full refund. No problem at all.
Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Oh. Well... okay. Thank you. That's all I needed. I appreciate you making that easy.
Of course. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your family all the best.
